entities.name: Marianus III of Arborea
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marianus III, also Mariano d'Arborea, was the sole Judge of Arborea from at least 1310 to his death. He co-ruled with his elder brother Andreotto from the death of their father, John of Arborea, who left no legitimate heirs when he died sometime between 1304 and 1307.
